name: employment-legal
description: Hire and termination reviews, worker classification, leave tracking, separation agreements, and investigation support.
author: Anthropic

skills.name: cold-start-interview
skills.description: Initial practice profile setup — learns your headcount, jurisdictions, HR systems, and employment law posture in 10-15 minutes

skills.name: termination-review
skills.description: Review a proposed termination for legal risk, documentation gaps, and jurisdiction-specific notice requirements

skills.name: hiring-review
skills.description: Screen offer letters, job postings, and background-check practices against your jurisdiction's requirements

skills.name: leave-tracker
skills.description: Track employee leave requests against FMLA, state leave laws, and company policy

skills.name: classification-check
skills.description: Assess worker classification risk (employee vs. contractor) under applicable federal and state tests

skills.name: separation-agreement
skills.description: Draft a separation agreement and release tailored to the employee's tenure, jurisdiction, and age
